description: The exchange of thoughts, messages, or information, as universally exchanged by speech, signals, writing, or behaviour between persons and/or organizations.

access.description: Access information, expressed as text, for the mode of universal communication such as 9 or *70 for a telephone network.

areaNumberCode.description: The code specifying the area number for this universal communication.

communicationChannelCode.description: The code specifying the channel or manner in which a universal communication can be made, such as telephone or email.

completeNumber.description: The text string of characters that make up the complete number for this universal communication.

countryNumberCode.description: The country access code for this universal communication number such as 44, 1, 353 etc.

description.description: A textual description of this universal communication.

emailURIId.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the email for this universal communication.

extensionNumber.description: The extension number, expressed as text, assigned to this universal communication number to enable a caller to reach a specific party.

hTMLPreferredIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not HTML format is preferred by the recipient for email universal communications.

invalidIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this universal communication is invalid.

localNumber.description: The universal communication number, expressed as text and not including country access code or the area number code, for this communication.

uRIId.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI), such as a web or an email address, for this universal communication.

useCode.description: The code specifying the use of this universal communication such as for business purposes or private.

websiteURIId.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the website for this universal communication.
